description: This file defines the 'IdSpan' struct, a primitive type for representing sequences of bytes used as identities within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It includes constructors, equality methods, serialization support, and utility functions for handling byte sequences and their string representations.

classes.name: IdSpan
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a sequence of bytes for identity purposes, supporting comparison, serialization, and string conversion.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan instance from a UTF8 string.

methods.name: AsSpan
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySpan<byte> representing the underlying byte array.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another IdSpan based on byte content or reference.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the cached hash code for the IdSpan.

methods.name: GetUniformHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: UnsafeCreate
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan with specified value and hash code, intended for internal use.

methods.name: UnsafeGetArray
methods.description: Retrieves the underlying byte array from an IdSpan.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a UTF8 string representation of the IdSpan.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format the IdSpan as a UTF8 string into a provided span.
